# rust.exe builds the binary `bin` names, with the profile and features
# given, and passes its path to targets that run it. A second run does
# nothing, a file Git ignores changes nothing, a source change rebuilds and
# reruns what uses the binary, and a cleaned binary restores from the cache.
[!exec:cargo] skip
[!exec:git] skip

# Files Git ignores are not inputs, so the outputs of `run` are not.
exec git init -q

bit
stdout 'plain ▶ cargo build --bin greet --message-format json'
stdout 'loud ▶ cargo build --profile release --bin greet --features loud --message-format json'
stdout 'all ▶ cargo build --profile fast --bin greet --all-features --message-format json'
stdout 'count ▶ cargo build --bin count --message-format json'
stdout 'run ✔ ok'
grep '\Ahello\n\z' out/plain.txt
grep '\AHELLO\n\z' out/loud.txt
grep '\AHELLO!\n\z' out/all.txt
grep '\Acounting\n\z' out/count.txt
exists target/debug/greet target/release/greet target/fast/greet target/debug/count

bit
! stdout '✔ ok'
stdout 'plain · no changes'
stdout 'run · no changes'

cp main.rs.changed out/notes.txt
bit
! stdout '✔ ok'

# The runner's cp keeps the file's older mtime on macOS, which cargo reads as
# unchanged, so the system cp writes the change.
exec cp main.rs.changed src/main.rs
bit
stdout 'plain ▶ .*src/main\.rs'
stdout 'loud ✔ ok'
stdout 'all ✔ ok'
stdout 'run ✔ ok'
grep '\Ahi\n\z' out/plain.txt
grep '\AHI\n\z' out/loud.txt
grep '\AHI!\n\z' out/all.txt

bit --clean plain loud
! exists target/debug/greet target/release/greet
exists target/debug/count
bit
stdout 'plain ⇣ .*\(cached\)'
stdout 'loud ⇣ .*\(cached\)'
exec target/debug/greet
stdout '\Ahi\n\z'
exec target/release/greet
stdout '\AHI\n\z'

-- .gitignore --
/target
/out
-- BUILD.bit --
plain = rust.exe {
  bin = "greet"
}

loud = rust.exe {
  bin      = "greet"
  features = ["loud"]
  profile  = "release"
}

all = rust.exe {
  bin          = "greet"
  all_features = true
  profile      = "fast"
}

count = rust.exe {
  bin = "count"
}

run = exec {
  command = "mkdir -p out && #{plain.path} > out/plain.txt && #{loud.path} > out/loud.txt && #{all.path} > out/all.txt && #{count.path} > out/count.txt"
  outputs = ["out/plain.txt", "out/loud.txt", "out/all.txt", "out/count.txt"]
}
-- Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "greet"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[features]
loud = []
excited = []

[profile.fast]
inherits = "dev"
-- src/main.rs --
fn main() {
    let word = "hello";
    let word = if cfg!(feature = "loud") { word.to_uppercase() } else { word.to_owned() };
    let mark = if cfg!(feature = "excited") { "!" } else { "" };
    println!("{word}{mark}");
}
-- main.rs.changed --
fn main() {
    let word = "hi";
    let word = if cfg!(feature = "loud") { word.to_uppercase() } else { word.to_owned() };
    let mark = if cfg!(feature = "excited") { "!" } else { "" };
    println!("{word}{mark}");
}
-- src/bin/count.rs --
fn main() {
    println!("counting");
}
